\section{Implementation Details}
\subsection{Configuration}
We ran our experiments on T5-small and T5-base models implemented using Hugging Face transformers. All the models are initialized with pre-trained weights and fine-tuned on specific datasets using AdamW optimizer with 0.001 initial learning rate and scheduled linear decay. Key-value head grouping is only applied to decoder self-attention and cross-attention blocks, as mentioned in the original paper \cite{ainslie2023gqa}.

\subsection{Data and Fine-tuning}
We fine-tuned and evaluated our models using the CNN/Daily Mail, WMT 2014 German-English translation, and Multi-news datasets. We used only 500k rows for fine-tuning the WMT 2014 dataset due to limited computing resources. We trained all our models for 3 epochs with a batch size of 8 for the summarization tasks and a batch size of 32 for the translation task. We used an input length of 512 and an output length of 256 for the CNN/Daily Mail and WMT tasks. For the Multi-news summarization task, we used an input length of 2048 and an output length of 512 according to the configuration in \cite{ainslie2023gqa}. We used 4 V100 GPUs for all our experiments.
